conditions.title: Anaphylaxis / Allergic Reaction
conditions.desc: Volumes worked out by severity — mild skin reaction, mild systemic, severe systemic and localised — for diphenhydramine, Dex SP, epinephrine, atropine and terbutaline.

conditions.title: Babesia
conditions.desc: Imidocarb dipropionate for B. canis; atovaquone plus azithromycin for B. gibsoni and B. microti. Volumes and milligrams computed for the patient's weight.

conditions.title: Body Surface Area (Chemo BSA)
conditions.desc: Body surface area in m² from body weight, with common mg/m² doses converted to milligrams for the patient in front of you. Clinician reference.

conditions.title: Car Sickness
conditions.desc: Cerenia, acepromazine, dimenhydrinate and meclizine for travel sickness, with separate dog and cat dosing.

conditions.title: Cholangiohepatitis
conditions.desc: Amoxicillin plus a quinolone, with or without metronidazole; ursodiol, prednisolone and the supportive drugs (famotidine, Cerenia, mirtazapine). Includes anaesthesia premed and induction for liver biopsy.

conditions.title: CKCS Anaesthesia (Mitral Insufficiency)
conditions.desc: Anaesthetising a dog with mild to moderate chronic mitral insufficiency — quarter-rate fluids, midazolam and opioid premed, preoxygenation, midazolam then propofol to effect. Clinician reference.

conditions.title: Dermatophytosis (Ringworm)
conditions.desc: Itraconazole, terbinafine and griseofulvin doses for cats and dogs with the terbinafine tablet charts, plus the topical regimens that have to run alongside.

conditions.title: Energy Requirement Calculator
conditions.desc: Resting and maintenance energy requirement from body weight, with the k factors for dogs and cats by life stage, plus expected water intake and the PU/PD threshold. Clinician reference.

conditions.title: Fluid Rates
conditions.desc: Maintenance and dehydration-deficit fluid rates for dogs (60 ml/kg/day) and cats (45 ml/kg/day), with the potassium supplementation table and Mandelker's SQ fluid/furosemide protocol. Clinician reference.

conditions.title: Greyhound Normal Values
conditions.desc: Breed-specific reference intervals from Idexx — chemistry, haematology and total T4 — alongside the general canine ranges. No weight or medication needed.

conditions.title: Hepatic Lipidosis
conditions.desc: Sharon Center's feline hepatic lipidosis protocol — feeding tube first, l-carnitine, taurine, B vitamins, zinc, vitamin E, SAMe or NAC, and the fluid and refeeding cautions.

conditions.title: Hookworms — resistant / chronic shedding
conditions.desc: Multi-drug-resistant Ancylostoma caninum in retired racing greyhounds and other breeds: the moxidectin + Drontal Plus combination protocol, Profender rescue, and how to test for resistance.

conditions.title: Hyperlipidemia
conditions.desc: Hypertriglyceridemia in dogs — low-fat diet, chitosan fibre, omega-3, bezafibrate, plus the clinical signs that follow a rising triglyceride level.

conditions.title: Immune-Mediated Thrombocytopenia (ITP)
conditions.desc: Steroids, cyclosporine, doxycycline and vincristine for dogs; prednisolone, cyclosporine and chlorambucil for cats. Includes the full prednisone taper and the GI protection that goes with it.

conditions.title: Lupoid Onychodystrophy
conditions.desc: Niacinamide plus tetracycline (or doxycycline/minocycline), vitamin E and essential fatty acids, escalating to pentoxifylline. Also covers plasma cell pododermatitis.

conditions.title: Lyme Nephritis
conditions.desc: Doxycycline, an ACE inhibitor or ARB, mycophenolate, anti-thrombotic aspirin, fish oils and a renal diet — with Dr Goldstein's preference for pulse dexamethasone if steroids are needed.

conditions.title: Megaesophagus
conditions.desc: Vertical feeding, food consistency, meal frequency and the drug trials (omeprazole, sildenafil, metoclopramide) — Sherri Wilson's management approach, plus owner support.

conditions.title: Oral Sedation / Chill Protocol
conditions.desc: Pre-visit sedation for dogs — the gabapentin + melatonin + acepromazine Chill Protocol, the Ace/Telazol meatball for severe cases, phenobarb + gabapentin, and trazodone with its weight chart. Clinician reference.

conditions.title: Reflux Esophagitis (the Gulpies)
conditions.desc: Gulping and repeated swallowing in dogs — omeprazole, metoclopramide and sucralfate, with the meal-timing routine that makes or breaks the response.

conditions.title: Sebaceous Adenitis
conditions.desc: Cyclosporine, vitamin A, isotretinoin and essential fatty acids, plus the topical descaling and moisturising protocol (baby-oil soaks, sulfur/salicylic shampoos, phytosphingosine).

conditions.title: Seizure Medications
conditions.desc: Maintenance antiseizure drugs (phenobarbital, levetiracetam IR/XR, zonisamide, KBr), emergency protocols, refractory status, cluster prevention. Includes XR tablet-splitting evidence.

conditions.title: Skin Conditions
conditions.desc: Itch control (Apoquel, Zenrelia, Numelvi), antibiotics, steroids, antifungals, omega-3 supplements, ivermectin protocols.

conditions.title: Snuffling Cat
conditions.desc: Chronic feline upper respiratory / rhinosinusitis — Cerenia for congestion, pulse-dosed azithromycin, famciclovir, saline flushing, and the supportive protocol (Mandelker).

conditions.title: Tapeworms — not responding to routine doses
conditions.desc: Higher-dose praziquantel for Spirometra in cats, and the Panacur 100 mg/kg × 6 days protocol for Dipylidium that keeps coming back after Droncit.

conditions.title: Thunderstorm Phobia
conditions.desc: Daily SSRIs (fluoxetine, sertraline) plus event medication given before the storm — alprazolam, trazodone with its weight chart, diazepam, lorazepam, atenolol, clonidine and Sileo.

conditions.title: Urinary Incontinence & Dyssynergia
conditions.desc: Sphincter incompetence versus reflex dyssynergia — Proin, DES and Incurin for females; tamsulosin, prazosin and bethanechol for males; plus how the residual urine volume tells the two apart.

conditions.title: Uveitis
conditions.desc: Anterior uveitis in dogs — topical steroids or NSAIDs, cycloplegics, doxycycline, and the systemic work-up that should run alongside. Clinician reference.

conditions.title: Vomiting & Diarrhea
conditions.desc: Cerenia, antacids, sucralfate, metronidazole, anti-diarrheals, tylosin, probiotics, dewormers, dexamethasone & B12 protocols, bland diet instructions.
